name: browser-sqlite
description: Browser SQLite with concurrent read / serial write isolation, backed by Web Workers and wa-sqlite
author: LAlex

scripts.test: node scripts/bounded.mjs 900 rstest && node scripts/bounded.mjs 900 rstest --config rstest.firefox.config.ts && node scripts/bounded.mjs 600 rstest --config rstest.isolated.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/bounded.mjs 900 rstest --project 'chromium*' && node scripts/bounded.mjs 900 rstest --config rstest.firefox.config.ts
scripts.test:conformance: node scripts/bounded.mjs 900 rstest --config rstest.conformance.config.ts && node scripts/bounded.mjs 900 rstest --config rstest.conformance.firefox.config.ts
scripts.bench:serve: npx --yes kill-port 8099 && pnpm bench:build && node scripts/static-server.mjs _site 8099

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && npx lint-staged && if [ -f "$(git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD)" ]; then pnpm test; else pnpm test:unit; fi
simple-git-hooks.pre-merge-commit: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec biome ci . && pnpm test
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec biome ci . && pnpm docs:vfs && git diff --exit-code VFS.md && pnpm test
